name: 2009 - 2010 Graduation Outcomes - Regents-based Math- ELA APM - School Level
description:
This dataset reports 2009–2010 graduation outcomes for New York City high schools, focusing on students who met the Regents-based Advanced Performance Measure (APM) in both math and English Language Arts. Each row represents a school and demographic group, identified by school code (dbn) and school name, with demographic categories such as All Students, English Language Learners, English Proficient, Special Education, and General Education.

For each school-demographic combination, the data includes the total graduation cohort size and the number and percentage of students meeting the math and ELA APM, reported separately for June and August. June figures reflect outcomes at the end of the regular school year, while August figures capture students who completed requirements after summer school. Percentages are calculated relative to the cohort, and some values are missing where data were not reported or groups were too small.

The dataset can be used to compare APM attainment across schools and student subgroups, examine gaps between general education and special education or English language
